tagline: Bread at seven, buns at nine, gone by noon.

hero.title: Baked on Harbor Street since this morning
hero.body: Sourdough, rye and cinnamon buns from one wood oven. Every word on this page lives in a JSON file, and you can change it without touching the code.

news.title: News
news.empty: Nothing new this week. Come in for bread.

edit.title: Change these words
edit.body: Run `bun run cms` in apps/copy-desk and open http://localhost:4707. Each file in content/ is a form: change a line, save, reload this page. Add a language there and translate each line next to the original.
edit.published: A post shows here when its published is 1. Set it to 0 to take it down.

footer: Made with Rusty Buns. The words are in content/*.json.
